description.value: Ethical Bean Coffee is a Vancouver-based coffee roaster founded in 2003, certified 100% fair trade and organic from day one, sourcing Arabica beans seasonally from Central and South America with full crop-to-cup traceability. The Kootenay Street address is tagged in OSM as a café associated with the brand's Canadian roasting operations. Cyclists stopping here would be drinking coffee roasted by one of Canada's most recognized ethical sourcing brands.

The URL was auto-discovered rather than sourced from OSM tags, suggesting it is the brand's corporate site rather than a page specific to this café location.
